schemaGaps.statement: No name normalization or cross-type dedup across Service entities: 'AC Tune-Up', 'A/C Tune Up', and 'Air Conditioner Tune-Up' project to 3 separate ping.social.service@1 objects, and 'WATER SOFTENER INSTALL' projects as both a service and a product. The schema has no canonical-name field and no duplicate-candidate signal, so downstream consumers cannot tell near-duplicates apart from distinct offerings.

Four distinct location entities collapse to one ping.social.location@1 object with no record of the dropped locations. PipelineReport has no 'merged/discarded entities' ledger, so the surviving location silently stands in for all four and the inconsistent naming variants are lost.

OG business:contact_data facts are discovered (9 opengraph facts) but never project onto business object fields: businessPhone is null despite business:contact_data:phone_number being present. The fact tier exists, the projection mapping does not.

Body-text extraction is minimal: a dotted phone (970.555.0184), a street address in a sentence, and prose hours produce zero facts; only the <title> yields one html-meta fact. The AcquiredSource schema covers this input shape, but the extraction pipeline has no text-pattern fact path, so metadata-poor sites produce near-empty graphs with no signal that facts were left in the text.

The nameless Person (jobTitle 'Dispatcher', no name) is dropped silently: 12 Person nodes in, 11 person objects out, unsupportedCount 0. A malformed-but-real entity vanishes with no unsupported record, so there is no way to distinguish 'site had 11 people' from 'site had 12 people and one was dropped'.

Cross-layer conflict is resolved silently by SOURCE_PRIORITY with no conflict record in PipelineReport: json-ld phone (970) 555-0188 wins over og phone (970) 555-0189, and BOTH hours representations (openingHoursSpecification and meta opening_hours) are dropped as unmapped-property unsupported, leaving businessHours null. The fixture preserves both values with provenance; the schema cannot represent 'two sources disagreed'. This is the confirmed silent-winner gap.
